game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar, an altar half-sunk in earth: the scholar mage must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar: an altar half-sunk in earth
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Signed values: declare resource as int, apply -resource, and print each result with %d. Dataset 8 starts with [-3, 0, 14, 17]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sunken Altar'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

source_player_objective: Protect the moon altar from rune wisps in Sunken Altar: keep the slice_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: slice_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
hint: Declare before use. int resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %d.
